verdict.rationale: Fedora's own docs explicitly claim 'all the packages, tools and runtimes you might need, up to date and ready for use with just a single command' plus container tooling with 'no setup required,' directly matching the story. However, this is vendor marketing copy only; there's no independent/hands-on evidence in the pack confirming a single-command full dev environment setup, and some community comments (e.g. fedora-comm-15) describe needing extra steps for certain apps, suggesting friction. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the single-command claim, concrete examples of the command/toolset delivering runtimes, and resolution of community reports of setup friction.
